title: API contract evolution boundary
request: Compare the two technically viable API evolution approaches in visible evidence. Neither is declared correct or preferred. Return a FinalAnswer Decision whose primary_evidence_id is exactly final-api-a or final-api-b and whose final_choice is exactly compatibility_envelope or capability_negotiation. Do not use tools.

evidence.content: Evidence A-14: a compatibility envelope keeps the legacy response shape while optional fields are introduced behind an explicit version window. It gives strict clients a tested rollback path, although the server must temporarily maintain two representations. Choice id: compatibility_envelope.

Evidence A-41: capability negotiation lets each client advertise supported features and receive the richest compatible response. It supports independent adoption without a global version switch, although negotiation logic adds a new coordination surface. Choice id: capability_negotiation.
